papers.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
papers.desc: Elastic Latent Recurrence trains looped language models without a one-loop tax, using a gated state update with a learned step size, mixed loop counts within each update, and loop-index and budget conditioning; on 4B and 30B-A3B hybrid models one loop matches the non-recurrent baseline and four loops add 4.75 to 7.25 points.

papers.title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
papers.desc: Shows that quantization error injected early in a recurrent-depth language model's loop is damped by later iterations and runs the first 24 of Huginn-0125's 32 recurrent steps in FP8 and the last 8 in BF16, keeping prefill NLL within 0.0001 of BF16 at 4K context with up to 1.16x H100 speedup and no retraining.

papers.title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement
papers.desc: Eco-RNA is an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model whose input-conditioned shared Transformer core is iterated a chosen number of times, trained with sampled depths and a fixed-point displacement penalty; RNAGym fitness Spearman rises from 0.242 at one iteration to 0.286 at four, beating Evo 2 40B with 500x fewer parameters.

papers.title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
papers.desc: Controlled ARC-AGI-1 study that crosses pretraining and per-task test-time-training budgets for the recursive TRM and the ViT-based VARC; more test-time sample presentations always help, more test-time task variants mainly help TRM, and pretraining lifts TRM's best pass@2 from 19.63 to 37.50 percent.

papers.title: Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage
papers.desc: Introduces fixed-first training for prelude-core-coda looped transformers, holding loop depth fixed for most of training and sampling depths uniformly only in a short final phase, cutting modeled training compute by 31-45 percent at 200M parameters while keeping mean NLL across inference depths within 0.5 percent.

papers.title: Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Proves that a looped linear-attention block trained on all-pairs graph connectivity converges to an update rule with a single effective parameter, which yields a finite window of useful test-time loop counts and certifies shallow-to-deep extrapolation to harder graphs.

papers.title: SpikCTU: A Compact Spiking Network with Adaptive Recurrent Computation for Speech Command Recognition
papers.desc: Introduces SpikCTU, a spiking speech-command model that iterates a shared Continuous Thinking Unit with low-rank stage adapters over a fixed memory, reaching 96.60 percent on SHD with 0.16M parameters and cutting recurrent steps by 59-67 percent with confidence-based early exit.

papers.title: Fitting Every Hint Is Not Enough: Premature Floods in Recurrent Algorithmic Reasoners
papers.desc: Shows that recurrent algorithmic reasoners that fit every BFS hint can prematurely flood deep graphs through hidden-state drift on tail-distribution inputs; detaching state between steps removes the flood (0 of 23 seeds versus 6 of 23 under BPTT) but not for sum-aggregation or residual processors.

papers.title: Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.desc: Introduces Tab-Loop, which replaces TabICLv2's 12 untied in-context-learning blocks with 4 tied blocks looped k times, matching the untied baseline at equal compute with 62 percent fewer parameters and raising TabArena Elo from 1288 to 1424 as loops grow from one to four.

papers.title: RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
papers.desc: Introduces RELAGRAM, a 0.53M-parameter TRM-style latent-recursive edge-token transformer for capacitated vehicle routing that reaches an 8.30 percent gap on CVRP-100 and transfers zero-shot to CVRP-1000, though a matched single-pass control shows no significant gain from recursion.

papers.title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
papers.desc: Shows that running Ouro and Huginn recurrent-depth language models at fewer loops removes refusal far faster than task ability, traces this to an unsettled refusal direction, and restores shallow-depth safety with a random-loop LoRA safety objective.

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopQuant, a post-training quantization method for looped language models with loop-shared transforms, loop-wise activation precision allocation and per-loop calibration; at W4A4 on Ouro-2.6B it beats W4A8 baselines while cutting memory by 65.3 percent and speeding decoding 1.7x.

papers.title: Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning
papers.desc: Shows that failed Tiny Recursive Model trajectories carry their failure in the answer state and introduces Gated Answer Resampling, which restarts halting-head-rejected puzzles with a resampled answer state and lifts TRM from 85.9 to 99.4 percent on Sudoku- Extreme.

papers.title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopREG, which re-applies the representation-supervised block of a REG diffusion Transformer within each denoiser call and adds visits at inference; one extra visit cuts SiT-B/2 ImageNet FID from 14.71 to 5.34.

papers.title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models
papers.desc: Inspects eight released looped language models with five mechanistic lenses and finds that most tokens are decided at the first iteration, attention heads keep fixed roles, and carry-loop models collapse under state noise while prompt-re-reading loops stay robust.

papers.title: Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think
papers.desc: Shows that slowly decaying oscillatory modes rate-limit convergence of recurrent reasoners and introduces QRR, a gauge-equivariant looped block that halts on a quotient- space fixed-point residual, reaching 97.9 percent on Sudoku-Extreme with a median halt step of 27 versus 122 for FPRM.

papers.title: Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners
papers.desc: Introduces Input-Conditioned Search, which scales frozen Tiny Recursive Models at test time by rerunning them under hypothesis-injected or restated inputs, shows that input changes can remove incorrect attracting fixed points, and raises Sudoku-Extreme accuracy from 87.85 to 99.81 percent.

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing
papers.desc: Applies tiny-recursive-model training (deep supervision, truncated recursion, ACT halting, deduction lattices) to weight-shared recurrent message passing, reaching about 99 percent on Sudoku-Extreme with 16k parameters and transferring zero-shot to larger N-Queens and SAT instances.

papers.title: Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine
papers.desc: Analyzes the recurrent tick map of an ImageNet Continuous Thought Machine, showing each tick is an attracting but strongly non-normal map whose state trails a moving fixed point by one tick, and that shuffling attention queries across images costs only 7 percent of accuracy.

papers.title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction
papers.desc: Shows that a single looped linear-attention layer can emulate dynamic mode decomposition in context and builds Test-Time Forecasting models that, trained only for one-step prediction, forecast out-of-distribution ODE and PDE dynamics with error falling as loops increase.

papers.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Separates computation, retention and reuse in a weight-tied looped transformer executing Mealy machines, showing that final-only training keeps just 22 percent of loop-32 answers at loop 64 while supervising one random position per example keeps 99.8 percent.

papers.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
papers.desc: Introduces LatentLoop, a looped MoE whose middle block runs its first visit on a 2x-compressed sequence and its second at full resolution with shared experts and per-visit attention, achieving the lowest validation loss at all 15 matched budgets from 1.3B to 7B parameters.

papers.title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
papers.desc: Fine-tunes natively looped LMs into single-pass multiple-choice decision models that read the options after every loop step, with a learned stopper choosing depth per question; a 2.6B LEV rises from 63.2 to 76.2 percent on JevBench from depth 1 to 4 and on-demand depth saves 15 to 24 percent of compute.

papers.title: AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder
papers.desc: Loops a span of frozen pretrained vision-encoder blocks with shared question-conditioned AdaLN modulation inside a VLM and stops when answers stabilize; on six procedural visual-reasoning tasks it lifts Qwen2.5-VL-3B to 64.6 percent vs 60.0 for a parameter-matched single-pass baseline.

papers.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Adds a lightweight drafter that predicts several future tokens from early-loop states of a frozen looped LM and uses intermediate-loop feedback to pause wrong branches in a depth-pipelined batch, reaching up to 7.82x lossless decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding on Ouro and Raven models.

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones
papers.desc: Prunes layers from TinyLLaVA's language backbone and loops an 8-layer core with a shared linear input-injection adapter, then recovers it with distillation; the retrofitted VLM averages 58.13 vs 55.80 for the unpruned model on nine benchmarks while storing 23.3 percent fewer language parameters.

papers.title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Adds a causal latent workspace to a four-round anchored shared-block Transformer: positions write gated vectors into prefix slots and read content-addressed summaries between rounds; at 101.71M parameters it reaches byte-level perplexity 2.7820 on WikiText-103, about 1% better than the best non-workspace control.

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
papers.desc: Isolates recurrence placement, input injection and recurrent-state design in looped LMs at matched scale, favoring a Huginn-style prelude-core-coda sandwich with input injection; at 730M parameters and 336B tokens it beats Ouro on all ten benchmarks, and the advantage carries to 8B-A0.8B MoE models.

papers.title: Look, Reason, Draw a Region: Recursive Refinement for Spatial Context Prediction
papers.desc: Introduces Spatial-TRM, an 11.2M-trainable-parameter weight-tied two-state recursive reasoner over frozen DINOv3 vision-language features with a convex region decoder; it reaches 29.51 percent context accuracy on RoboSpatial-Home, 9.02 points above a parameter-matched single-step model.

papers.title: RTSM: Adapting Recursive Models to Multivariate Time-Series Classification
papers.desc: Adapts TRM-style weight-tied refinement to multivariate time-series classification with a convolutional tokenizer, a single-state shared attention module applied 48 times, and a pooled readout; it reaches 72.81 percent mean accuracy on the 30 UEA datasets, 1.60 points above MambaSL.

papers.title: Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
papers.desc: Reapplies a pretrained shared GNN processor beyond its training depth to generalize to larger graphs, and introduces Loop-Freeze-Steer, a small FiLM controller that steers the frozen processor; on chip placement it comes within 4% of full fine-tuning while training 2.9% of the parameters.

papers.title: Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks
papers.desc: Probes weight-tied Transformers on multi-hop permutation traversal and finds the loop advances through intermediate hops in a staircase across iterations; a four-layer block looped eight times solves the task in 5 of 5 seeds, while an identically trained untied 32-layer model solves it in none.

papers.title: Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing
papers.desc: Splits a recursive Transformer's core into contiguous blocks that are each looped R times before the next, between layer-wise repetition and whole-stack cycling; at 360M scale with two loops it reaches 40.20 average accuracy with 157M unique parameters versus 39.74 for a 315M vanilla model.

papers.title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop
papers.desc: Upcycles a pretrained LLM by looping each selected middle layer locally and gating the attention and MLP residual writes of later loops per layer and loop; from Qwen3-4B Base with SFT, the 20-benchmark average rises from 51.90 (non-looped) to 58.07 at three loops, past the usual two-loop saturation.

papers.title: Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere
papers.desc: Runs a weight-tied normalized-Transformer block as a damped fixed-point solver on the unit hypersphere with geodesic injection, slerp damping and angular halting, proves convergence conditions, and reaches 96.6% on Sudoku-Extreme, 87.9% on Maze-Hard and 59.1% on Mini-ARC.

papers.title: Internalizing Chain-of-thought into Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Constructs constant-bit-size looped Transformers that apply one shared decoder block L times per generated token, interpolating between chain-of-thought and latent thought; they simulate time-t, space-s Turing machines with both the context window and the number of generated tokens cut by a factor of L.

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.desc: Fits an effective-parameter scaling law over nearly 600 looped-Transformer runs varying forward and backpropagated loops; full BPTT through fewer loops beats truncated BPTT at matched compute, and two fully trained loops beat the compute-optimal non-looped model with 27% fewer parameters at 8% more compute.

papers.title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM
papers.desc: Adds a persistent intermediate state, updated by the same shared operator that nests repeated fast-state updates, to HRM, TRM and URM at matched parameter counts; on ARC-AGI-1 under a single-GPU budget the nested variants show no consistent gain, and exact solving stays near zero for all models.

papers.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
papers.desc: Pretrains recAMPLIFY, a masked protein language model whose weight-tied Transformer core refines residue states over adjustable cycles; with 155M unique parameters on 2T tokens it beats AMPLIFY-350M on fold accuracy (0.696 vs 0.568), and Gated Mixture Recurrence halting cuts expected cycles by 32 to 40%.

papers.title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
papers.desc: Jointly fine-tunes looped Ouro and HRM-Text models against Qwen3 on 13 clinical NLP datasets, finding Ouro-1.4B-Thinking beats Qwen3-1.7B on 11 of 13 and Ouro-2.6B-Thinking is competitive with Qwen3-8B, with the largest gains on inference and question answering.

papers.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
papers.desc: Trains each iteration of a retrofitted Qwen2.5-0.5B prelude-core-coda loop to match the state after the first k operations and rescales recurrent states to first-iteration norms, reaching 95.5% swap-S5 accuracy at 16x the training length versus 55.7% for RLT.

papers.title: HistoLoop: Iterative Contextual Inference with a Looped Transformer for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
papers.desc: Predicts spatial gene expression from H&E images with a shared spatial Transformer and retrieval module looped coarse-to-fine over persistent spot states, reaching 0.480 macro HVG50 Pearson correlation on HEST-Bench versus 0.386 for a parameter-matched unlooped model.

papers.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
papers.desc: Runs a causal encoder once to build fixed per-layer global KV caches that a weight-tied decoder attends to on every iteration, beating full-stack looping at matched effective depth from 60M to 1B and lifting 1B zero-shot average accuracy from 49.58% to 50.85%.

papers.title: Present but Hard to Read: Probing Latent Reasoning with Minimal Pairs
papers.desc: Shows with minimal-pair probes that a copied digit is present in looped Ouro-1.4B's state even when standard probes read it at 0.36, and finds an intermediate a+b value that is readable across loops but not used for the answer under patching.

papers.title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
papers.desc: Measures exactly, from one backward pass, how much weight gradient truncated backprop drops on nine looped language models; the lost share barely changes from 32 to 64 loops, keeping two of Ouro's four loops loses 81% of the final output's gradient, and the loss falls by 0.07-0.22 during fine-tuning.

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Loops a two-block slice of a 170M uniform-diffusion denoiser inside each denoising step with random loop counts in training, matching a non-looped model's validation NLL with up to 2.8x (OpenWebText) and 3.3x (FineWeb-Edu) fewer training FLOPs and up to 9.8% lower generative perplexity at matched NFE.

papers.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
papers.desc: Introduces LoopRec, which recurses one weight-shared recommender block and lets a learned gate stop or continue each history item at every recursion; it improves all 48 backbone-dataset-metric comparisons over fixed-depth SASRec, BSARec, NextItNet and LRURec, by up to 37% NDCG@20.

papers.title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces LoopLook, which re-applies a middle-to-late window of a pretrained VLM vision encoder with shared weights, question-conditioned modulation, a learned exit head and token-wise fusion of loop states; on Qwen2.5-VL-3B it lifts MMStar from 55.9 to 64.5 at 5.1-6.5% extra time to first token.

papers.title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models
papers.desc: Compares weight-tied looped and depth-grown language models up to 3B with dense models of matched inference FLOPs and effective depth, finding that both learn in-context earlier, keep that ability longer and lean more on induction heads, though the 3B looped model trails dense on nine-task MC (60.53 vs 61.33).

papers.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
papers.desc: Reuses the final recurrence's KV-cache for all earlier recurrences of a looped LM; stochastic-depth pretraining makes this work, and BeNice!, a post-training loss, keeps the first recurrence compatible with the shared cache.

papers.title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models
papers.desc: Shows that extra loop steps stay usable because training and inference loops agree, not because of loop-boundary normalisation: removing Ouro's between-step norm drops it to zero accuracy at its trained budget, yet 19M models trained without it extrapolate better (0.932 vs 0.584 at 8x budget).

papers.title: Do Halting Heads Really Save Compute in Looped Language Models?
papers.desc: Pretrains looped language models up to 1.3B with halting heads and finds that mixture-loss heads still run 7.6-7.9 of 8 iterations, while early-stopping per-step heads lose most of their 0.02 BPB lead once batched passes run until the slowest token stops; proposes a pre-training test that bounds a head's gain.

papers.title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
papers.desc: Introduces Accordion, a 6B-A0.5B MoE language model that runs each layer of a growing prefix of its middle window twice to offer five depth budgets from one set of weights; after 3.6T tokens the deepest budget lifts a 37-task average from 47.05 to 50.06, and the middle budget keeps 89% of the gain.

papers.title: Edge-RecViT: Efficient Vision Transformer via Semantic-Refined Dynamic Recursion
papers.desc: Introduces Edge-RecViT, combining a fully shared recursive ViT hidden layer with an edge-aware token ranker that allocates per-token depth and early exits for parameter- and FLOP-efficient vision.

papers.title: Implicitly-Defined Neural Networks for Sequence Labeling
papers.desc: Defines sequence hidden states jointly through a learned implicit system and solves the coupled nonlinear equations to enable non-causal bidirectional interactions for sequence labeling.

papers.title: ChainGPT: Dual-Reasoning Model with Recurrent Depth and Multi-Rank State Updates
papers.desc: Introduces ChainGPT, a dual-reasoning recurrent-depth architecture that combines multi-substep state updates and state-guided sparse attention to move reasoning into latent computation, with adaptive stopping as a supporting mechanism.

papers.title: MoDr: Mixture-of-Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Test-Time Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces MoDr, which adds multi-branch routing to a depth-recurrent Transformer so looped models can explore solution paths more adaptively at test time.

papers.title: Polymorphic Universal Transformer
papers.desc: Introduces the Polymorphic Universal Transformer, adding conditional sparse subspaces and uncertainty-aware depth scheduling to shared-parameter recurrence to reduce compute while mitigating representational collapse.

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.desc: Argues that once a looped language model's recurrent states approach fixed points, the endpoint can replace the trajectory, enabling truncated backpropagation, terminal KV sharing, distilled prefill up to 1.79x faster, and RL updates from saved rollout states about 2x faster; it shapes those fixed points with a depth prior learned from prediction feedback plus an entropy term and with orthogonal input injection, and at 1.6B parameters the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

papers.title: Universal Speech Transformer
papers.desc: Adapts the Universal Transformer to speech recognition with shared iterative encoder and decoder computation, dynamic depth, one-time positional encoding, and full hidden-state updates.
